name: White shell top, V insert (female, worn under the blue blazer)
size_basis: Original flat art. The regulation names a white shell top (4.2.4.2.2) but gives no figure or dimensions; scoop depth and width are estimates for the women's blazer base V.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: a white shell top may be worn instead of the shirt; the blazer must be worn; no tie tab with it (CAPR 39-1 4.2.4.2.2, 4.2.4.3)
assumed: scoop width 4.6 in, depth about 1.3 in
